name: Realtime
description: Live topics over the WebSocket: publish to the people on a topic, end someone's membership, ask who is connected.

capabilities.name: Publish to a topic
capabilities.description: Send a message to everyone on one of the plugin's declared topics. Maps to kernel command realtime::publish.

capabilities.name: Drop a member from a topic
capabilities.description: End one person's membership of a topic at once (they left the channel). Maps to kernel command realtime::drop.

capabilities.name: Read presence
capabilities.description: List who is connected to a topic now. Maps to kernel command realtime::presence.
